verdict.rationale: Configurable cloud environments are a fair axis for a coding agent, but the evidence never documents an OpenCode feature for defining a reproducible cloud environment with dependencies and setup steps. Running tasks inside a GitHub Actions runner relies on the host platform's workflow configuration, not an OpenCode capability, so it earns no credit. A remote `serve` backend is likewise not an environment-configuration feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs
